Fix race condition in SessionLauncher.executor()

See merge request meganerd/electrictown!2

Fix race condition in SessionLauncher.executor() lazy init

The executor() method had a classic double-checked locking bug: it read
l.exec without synchronization before acquiring the lock. When Execute()
and Stop() ran concurrently (as in TestStop), the race detector caught
the unsynchronized read racing with the write inside the lock.

Fix: replace the manual double-checked lock with sync.Once, which is
purpose-built for exactly this pattern.
